title: | SABBATH AFTERNOON CLASS: The Red Man Psychosis: We Understand Why You Hate Us

sense.text:
The Red Man psychosis: delusion, agitation, aggression, hostility. The white man is agitated right now, and the majority of Esau who are agitated against us don’t even understand why they hate so-called black people. Kanye West said we are Shemitic, so that trigger word ‘anti-Semitic’ does not apply to us; he knows that because he’s been watching IUIC. They throw trigger words the same way they call you homophobic: I’m not afraid of you, I just don’t agree with it.

There is a religious delusion on Esau and on the other nations too: after all you’ve done to God’s people, you think you’re going to escape. You think you can just say ‘for God so loved the world’ and get off the hook. No, you got this Bible confused. “He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity.” You can’t chop and screw that scripture. Is there another way to explain it? If you led somebody into captivity, you’re going into captivity.

Other nations led us into captivity: you white man, you Chinese, East Indian, African, Arab, whatever you want to be, that destroyed God’s people, the so-called negro, the so-called Hispanics, the indigenous people scattered throughout the earth. You think you’re going to get away with it because you say you believe in Jesus. That is the psychosis.

Why does the white man, the red man, hate us? Because they know how great we are, and whenever someone is better than you, you try to tear him down. Here is the scripture that says we are better than them. They thought that because we went into slavery we wouldn’t know this Bible, but this word is spiritual.

“For thou art an holy people unto the Lord thy God”: that thee is you, it’s me, we’re the ones that fit the curses in Deuteronomy 28. The Bible wasn’t given to the one they call ‘no class’, ‘no vocabulary’; he can’t come debate us in our word. The word was meant for us; we don’t have to prove anything to him. He is as insignificant as a bump on my backside.

God chose us “to be a special people unto himself, above all people”. Not equal to: above. Is there another way to explain above? You’re either above or you’re below. The Israelites are a special people above all people. You don’t have to like it, but it says what it says, and if you want to stay in the spirit of psychosis, religious delusion, have at it, it won’t change it. Somebody is above somebody else; everybody’s not created equal.

“The Lord did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people”. So he loves us, but not because we were more in number. If God loves somebody, the opposite of love is hate: he hates somebody else. This is elementary, not the ten dragons and seven horns. God has somebody special, so somebody’s not special; somebody’s above, so somebody’s below; God loves somebody, so there’s somebody he hates.

“For ye were the fewest of all people”, but he loved us. Put yourself in the other nations’ shoes: these people ain’t that many, he created all of us, but he loves them. That would make me mad. If my birthright wasn’t Israel I would hate you too; that’s a rational thought. He loves you, he don’t love me; you’re special above me; I’m going to build some kind of hate towards you. Thank God I’m born Israel.

I can prove I’m Israel in this Bible; I could spend the next three or four hours proving without a doubt that we’re the Israelites, and only Israelites can do that. So I understand you, Red Man, I understand why you are upset. “Why do the heathen rage”? Because they ain’t special. Rage is violent, uncontrollable anger: I can’t stand you black people. And you’ve got some black people that can’t stand black people; they’re under a Stockholm Syndrome, and we’ll get to them, but right now it’s for the nations.

As much as I’m disgusted with the other nations, I won’t just go out and randomly kill one of them. But they will beat a black woman or a black child for nothing. Police will grab a little black girl, wrench up her arms, handcuff her, kick and stomp on her. Why be so angry you want to kill somebody that never did nothing to you? He’s jogging through a neighborhood and you track him down and shoot him. He’s sitting in his living room eating popcorn watching TV and you kick open the door, shoot him and say he was a threat. Their hatred is perpetual, and many of them don’t even understand that they’re wired like that.

“And the people imagine a vain thing”: that people is talking about us. We imagine a vain thing.

So why do the heathen rage? Because God chose us. I would rage too: God said he is in the midst of Israel and he is our God and none else.
“The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the Lord, and against his anointed”. The rulers of the earth came together and said: listen, we got a plan.

“Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.” The bands are the brotherhood between Judah and Israel. The nations came together with a plan: let us break the brotherhood. How did they break it? By telling us we’re not Israel, giving us different nationalities, and they did it through slavery. You take these to Central America and South America, you take them to French Guinea and Haiti, you take him to the Americas; give them different languages, Haitian, Spanish, French, English, and confuse them. The heathen were upset, so they said we have to separate all these people, disconnect them from their heritage, break their relationships, and once we do that we got them.

Meanwhile the kings and queens of Europe, in Russia, France, England and Spain, were all related, all cousins marrying each other. They understood to keep together, and they separated us.

“He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the Lord shall have them in derision.” God said: you stupid silly rabbit, tricks are for kids. You think your plot is going to work? You think you’re going to have my people like that? “Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath”.

That doesn’t mean we weren’t going into captivity; we still have to pay for what we did. But their plan was not going to be foolproof. They thought they were going to have us.

precepts.why:
This proves who the people are that “imagine vain things”. The Lord spoke it “by the mouth of thy servant David”, which is what we just read in Psalms 2. “The kings of the earth stood up, and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord, and against his Christ.” The kings of the earth at that time were the Romans; today you know them as Italians. The rulers were the Herodian …, the Idumeans; today you call them Jewish people.

Christ means the anointed. They were against the Lord Jesus Christ, and against us, his anointed, and today they are against us. As long as you think these other nations love you, you’re asleep. Christ had enemies, God had enemies, we have enemies. How many times do you have to get cracked in the skull to realize who your enemy is? You don’t realize it because you’ve got white man Jesus on your mind, and you’re in church saying forgive them for they know not what they do while your whole lower intestine is ripped out. Church make you stupid as hell. If somebody keeps doing something over and over again, obviously they know what the hell they’re doing; you can’t keep using that excuse for the white man’s evil. Take just the police in the last twenty years: forget crimes, count the murders they’ve gotten away with, one, two, five, ten, a hundred, and they’re still on lunch break, and you’re supposed to trust them? ‘Not all cops are bad’: I’m alive, but I ain’t stupid. Never trust your enemies.

“For of a truth against thy holy child Jesus, whom thou hast anointed, both Herod, and Pontius Pilate”. Herod is the Idumean, the so-called Jew: at one time we ruled over them and forcibly made them convert to keeping the commandments, and those guys today with the little things on the side of their heads banging their heads against the wall in Israel are Idumeans, not the real Jew. Jewish: the suffix means pertaining to, like a bluish shirt ain’t really blue. They ain’t really Jews; they just follow the customs of the Jews. The real Jew is you. Pontius Pilate was an Italian, an Edomite.

“With the Gentiles, and the people of Israel, were gathered together”: that is the people we read about in Psalms 2. It was our own people, under the delusion. Kanye West, even though what he said was true, believed White lives matter; Roland Martin, and on and on. I don’t care about no other nation but my people. I ain’t looking to harm nobody, but you don’t care about my welfare and I don’t care about yours. All I have in my corner is God, and that’s all I need; all this is going up in smoke and Christ’s kingdom is going to stand. The ones buying into the system, worried about losing their fame, the sports players that know about the Israelites: it ain’t for you to do the job. Stay quiet, support, and let us go to the front lines; we’re the grunts on these corners teaching these people, and we’re built for this. Kanye, we tip our hats that you went out and said what you said; we know where you got it from, and you spread it to the masses with a bigger platform.

This is why they’re raging, violently angry. “And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel, and that I am the Lord your God, and none else”. If I was them I’d be angry: you made everybody, but you’re only their God, and none else? What about me? I didn’t write this book, I’m just reading the words in it. He’s the God of Israel and none else; we are a special people above all people on the face of the earth, and he chose us not because we were more in number but because he loves us. That was his choosing; God, thank you.

“And my people shall never be ashamed.” But we’re in captivity, we’re low. Don’t worry, you won’t be ashamed. “And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh”: afterward, after we go into captivity. While you’re in this captivity, after you went through slavery and weren’t allowed to read, and came into a system that’s against you, I’m going to pour my spirit upon you.

“And your sons and your daughters shall prophesy”: the men, women and children will say, my name is Ben Israel, I’m from the tribe of Judah, I’m from the tribe of Levi. Little kids are going to know who they are. Give a report on a famous black man: I’m doing Jesus Christ. They’re going to prophesy in the same land where we were carried captive, and the heathen are going to be mad, they’re going to rage. Years ago one of my sons did a report on Christ being black, and his teacher was so hot, she hated it.

“Your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions”: visions from God. God is going to talk to us and give us visions. So I understand why they hate us.

What are the bands in “Let us break their bands asunder”? “Then I cut asunder mine other staff, even Bands, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.” That band is the brotherhood we had. So the nations came together and had a plan: let us break the brotherhood. And they broke it through slavery, by telling us we’re not Israel and giving us different nationalities.

sense.text:
I get it, other nations: we’re the only one with a God. The white man’s god is not real; it’s just a picture of a person they painted, an image that’s supposed to be a savior. The Chinese god is some fat guy sitting in the Chinese restaurant where you put a penny in the little thing. The East Indian got a god with eight arms and an elephant nose. Africans got a sun god; they worship frogs and trees. God said I ain’t your God, I’m only their God, so they make the tree, the stone, the frog, the sun and the moon their god. You guys are stupid as hell. Thank you Father, because we got a real God: he opened a sea for us and we walked through, and he killed nations for us. Show me one time in the Bible where God destroyed the Israelites to save the nations; I can show you time and time again where God destroyed the kings of the earth for us. We’re the only people with the only true and living God; everything else is false, it ain’t real, it’s fugazi.

“The earth is given into the hand of the wicked”. Who gave the earth into the hand of the wicked? God, because we were disobedient. God chose us, put us on, we’re the people he loves, but we didn’t listen, so he said I’m going to put this other man over you and give him the earth to rule, because you didn’t appreciate it. Now God says I’m going to take it back from you and give it back to the ones I want to.

I would be mad too: I got to taste a little bit of this and now I’m going to lose it again, so I’m going to try everything I can to stop you from knowing who you are. So you’re my enemy? I’ll fight you. They think they’re going to fight God, that big black man coming out of the sky. Christ said, when I come back I’m not going to meet you as a man; next time you see me I’m coming in full force, and you’re going to learn the hard way. You thought you were going to rule forever?

“He covereth the faces of the judges thereof”: when I say nations, I’m talking about Esau. He covers the faces of the judges and paints his image.

Who rules the earth today? Is it the African man? No. The Chinese man? He’s wealthy, but he don’t run it. The East Indian man? No. The Japanese? No. It’s the white man. He runs the earth today, here in America, there in Europe, down in Africa; his footprint is everywhere, and God gave it to them. “If not, where, and who is he?” Name another nation that runs the earth: there isn’t one. By elimination it could only be the Red Man. And what did God call him from the top? “The wicked.” So now we establish that he is the wicked.

precepts.why:
This is how he covers the faces of the judges. “And laid open the book of the law, wherein the heathen had sought to paint the likeness of their images.” They took the book and said: I got a plan. I’m going to paint myself; I’m going to make Jesus white, Moses white, Aaron, Solomon, David, everybody white, and make the devil black. Because they know ‘evil communication’ will corrupt our manners, and we would hate each other. That’s the master plan.

The churches can’t teach this. To all you Christian pastors, you Israelite pastors, you black pastors: we pray that you accept this word, because you have a platform with your people and could lead them to salvation, but you were educated in their theology schools. None of us have been to a theology school like that; we just know the word of God. The church has failed: these young people don’t believe in the church no more, they know it’s a hustle, and they never heard the word of God taught with power the way they’re hearing it taught now. That’s why you got people like Kanye repeating what Bishop Nathanyel is saying, and Kendrick Lamar, Kodak Black, Nick Cannon, the football players, Ice Cube.

You thought you had a game plan. God said: I’m going to laugh you to scorn. In that day I’m going to raise up my prophets right in the midst of you, and they’re going to prophesy, and they’re going to lead my people back.

sense.text: “He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the Lord shall have them in derision.” Your plan is not going to work. You think you’re going to paint your image, you think you’re going to put Christ as white, you think you’re going to put out this music and destroy this people. Christ said, I’m going to laugh and have you in derision.

“Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath”: he’s going to speak to them. Do you think God is going to come down and speak to them directly in his wrath? He’s going to speak to them by the mouth of the prophets. White man, you the devil, the deceiver, the wicked on the earth: he’s talking to you right now. You’re under psychosis, a strong religious delusion that you’re going to last forever.

That’s the red man psychosis, a spiritual delusion. Are you crazy? You did all that to God’s people and it’s going to go unchecked, unnoticed, like God forgot?

“Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.” His king is Christ, and his holy mountain is the government being established, by who? By you all. You all are establishing the mountain, the government, today, teaching with King Christ as the head.

“Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance”. He said ask. Father, have mercy upon us, forgive us for the sins we’ve committed against thee; we are thy people, we’re turning ourselves around; give us the heathen for an inheritance. You said ask. How about all of you ask God three times a day: Lord, forgive us and give them to me. I want all of them.

“And the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession”: I want all the earth to possess, every bit of it that’s left. I don’t want a house, I don’t want an acre; I want it all or none. Keep your pennies, keep your trinkets: all or nothing.

And I can understand why they’re upset. That means they’ve got to give up the earth: ‘I’m not giving it up, that ain’t fair. I got a plan. We’re going to destroy these people, we’re going to keep them in derision, we’re going to change their names and call them something else, we’re going to teach them how to twerk, men, boys and girls; give them dope; give them Christianity, Islam; give them sports.’

“Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.” … you, you’re the kings of the earth. I know we don’t look like it; they can’t perceive that we are that, but we are that. Be wise: ask of me and I’ll give it to you. If you bethink yourselves in the land whither you were carried captive, and repent, and make supplication to the Lord thy God, then will he hear your prayers. Be wise, fear God.
“Serve the Lord with fear, and rejoice with trembling”: that’s what we better do, serve.

“Kiss the Son, lest he be angry”: kiss the Son meaning Christ. Reverence Christ, lest he be angry with you and kill you right along with them, “and ye perish from the way”.

“When his wrath is kindled but a little”: when Christ returns in his wrath on this earth, it’s just going to be a little bit, because if he gave full force he would destroy everything; there’d be nothing left. He’s just going to turn it up a little bit. He can’t give the full intensity of his power; we can’t even explain what that is. We can’t stand the presence of an angel without dropping dead, much less his full power. “Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.”

And that being said, the heathen read this. They understand; they have all the records; they saw it through the books of God. They knew that we would be the elect, chosen of God. I can see why they would be angry, but it doesn’t mean anything.

precepts.why:
You’re under a delusion that it’s going to last forever: nobody is going to end me, kill me, get rid of me; it ain’t going to stop. It’s going to pass. “Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever”.

All nations at one time thought their nation was going to run the earth. The Egyptians thought they had it, until Moses came and the sea opened and the firstborn died. Babylon thought they had it, ‘we took everything over, we run it’, until the Persians and Medes came in and they fell. The Persians and Medes thought they had it; then came Alexander and destroyed that. The Greeks thought they had it until the Romans came. Rome had it, and the extension of Rome is America today: Babylon the Great, America. And you all think your kingdom’s going to be established forever? There’s one kingdom left to rule, and that’s Christ’s kingdom, the black Messiah. In that day and in that time when he returns, he’s going to breathe fire and burn this thing to hell in a handbasket, and the only ones left standing will be the righteous Israelites. The rest of you die off, and the rest of you alive will be going in shackles and chains to work in servitude. Thus is the gospel of Jesus.

“And their dwelling places to all generations”. You really believe you’re going to go up in a spaceship: ‘we’re going to shoot him down.’ Look, guy, you’re going to run out of fuel, you idiot. You guys are comical. It’s funny to you all, but we know that day when he comes back; even we’re going to be in fear of what we’re going to see.

“They call their lands after their own names”: they called it America after Vespucci, they called Africa after Africanus. They call the land after themselves, but that’s going to come to an end. It’s going to get stomped out.

sense.text:
I’m so warm today, I feel so good: I am born Israel, I’m an Israelite.

“The heathen shall envy thee, but they shall be able to do nothing against thee”. Why are those two things in the same verse? The heathen envy us, but they can’t do nothing against us, because, as we read in Psalms 2, the Lord is going to have them in derision; the Lord is only going to allow them to do so much. And out of envy comes hatred, murder. There you go: they’re so angry. ‘Damn it, I can’t stand a black skin.’ But they can’t do nothing against thee.

Go back to it: the heathen are going to envy you, but they’ll be able to do nothing against thee.

precepts.why:
You can be everything on this earth. You can call yourself black, Haitian; you can call yourself he, she, it, they, whatever. But the minute you say you’re Israel: trouble, Will Robinson. You know why it’s a problem calling yourself Israel? Because they fear that name. That’s why they didn’t want you to call yourself this.

“And all people of the earth shall see that thou art called by the name of the Lord; and they shall be afraid of thee.” There you go, buddy. Now you’re waking up, and time is short: ‘I thought we had a plan, I thought we had them.’

How many of you have experienced that? The minute they understand your nationality, that you know you’re an Israelite, they get unsettled; they don’t know how to act; they’re uncomfortable, and you’re not even reading the Bible to them. Just your presence unsettles them, because it’s bred in them to know something’s wrong. But when you talk about LeBron James and Lil Uzi Vert, and ‘I was at the Easter egg parade’, they’re not worried about you. Say ‘I just kept the day of atonement’: what do you know about that? Who told you about that?

They can’t do nothing against thee. “Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel”.

Hey buddy, that stupid rap music ain’t going to work. BET ain’t going to work. CNN ain’t going to work. The Christian network ain’t going to work. Church ain’t going to work. Sports ain’t going to work. We’re not falling for the banana in the tailpipe trick. We’re too smart, we’re too spiritual; you’re not going to move us off course. Our job is to raise up the twelve tribes of Israel. All your trick knowledge that you try to confuse us with, it’s going to work on some of them, but there’s a remnant it’s not going to work on. We ain’t falling for that; we’re not deviating.

“Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth”. That was it right there: their enchantments and sorceries, against a people that no enchantment works against.

“But these two things shall come to thee in a moment”, “the loss of children, and widowhood”: that’s going to happen real swift. “They shall come upon thee in their perfection for the multitude of thy sorceries, and for the great abundance of thine enchantments.”

An example of one of their sorceries: we read it earlier in First Maccabees, they sought to paint the image. Sorcery is controlling the mind of somebody. That’s what witchcraft is: when you can control the way people think, you can use them to do your bidding. The sorcery was drawing those images to confuse you and let you forget who you are, and then when you see that image you worship it, and you hate your black skin. That’s witchcraft.

The Christian church is the biggest form of witchcraft on earth. They have craftily separated the commandments from Christ. I don’t even know how you could believe in Christ and not keep the commandments, or keep the commandments and not believe in Christ. That witchcraft makes Haitian witchcraft look like a joke. Catholicism: big witchcraft. Their sorcery is not going to work.

Go back one chapter. “Many kings have I destroyed for their sakes”: damn, many kings have I destroyed for the Israelites’ sakes. “Pharaoh with his servants and all his power have I smitten down. All the nations have I destroyed before them, and in the east I have scattered the people of two provinces, even of Tyrus and Sidon, and have slain all their enemies.”

As a heathen I would say, damn, he’s destroying many kings for their sakes, nations for them. Man, I would hate you too. You know the mental stress that would put somebody under, to know that it doesn’t matter what I do, I have no hope as a people; we can never be right with God, because God never loved us from the beginning; we were fitted for destruction. And now we got a little taste of whatever little kingdom this is that we have, and we’re going to lose it. Man, I would shoot you in your back too. I would understand. I would do everything I can to keep you in the state that you’re in. So hey, you’re doing your job, buddy; we get it. That being said, it ain’t going to change. You’re going to captivity anyway. This is what it says.

sense.text: Remember, he just said he killed many kings for their sakes. “Thus saith the Lord, I brought this people out of bondage”, and gave them his commandments by the prophets, “whom they would not hear, but despised my counsels.” Damn: he killed kings for our sakes, he brought us out of Egypt, out of bondage, and yet we despised his counsel.

precepts.why: Here we go, because of that: “Let them be scattered abroad among the heathen, let their names be put out of the earth”. Now we’re African-American; we forgot who we are. Why? “For they have despised my covenant.” Because they despised his covenant, he let their names be put out of the earth.

“Go, and ye shall receive: pray for few days unto you, that they may be shortened: the kingdom is already prepared for you”. Wait a second. What happened in between the time we hated God and our names were put out of the earth, and now you’re talking about a kingdom prepared for us? Our name was put out of the earth; we went into captivity. And now in this same chapter we’re coming back, and a kingdom is prepared for us.

The heathen: ‘Oh no, come on God, this ain’t fair. You’re going to tell me they’re going to come back in place?’ Psychosis: ‘I hate them, I hate them, and they still win.’ How? Because we were chosen. About two-thirds of us are going to die, but for the elect: hey buddy, this game is rigged. You can never win; it’s impossible for your nation to ever win. The cards are not in your favor. The Bible reads the way it reads.

So now we’re going to pray for those days to be shortened. In between the time that we sinned and were brought down, where we forgot our names and they were put out of the earth, we spent all that time in captivity under the white man; we couldn’t read, we couldn’t do nothing, and today we’re doing stupid, dumb, evil stuff. And he says there’s a kingdom prepared for you. But what has to happen?

sense.text: “For thy help will I send my servants”: I’m going to send who? My servants. He said I’m going to send my prophets Isaiah and Jeremiah back on the earth; I’m going to put my spirit in them, and they’re going to come with “twelve trees laden with divers fruits”: diverse fruits meaning wisdom. They’re going to begin to instruct you again and get you right.

“Do right to the widow, judge for the fatherless, give to the poor, defend the orphan, clothe the naked, Heal the broken and the weak, laugh not a lame man to scorn, defend the maimed, and let the blind man come into the sight of my clearness.” All this is a metaphor for keeping the commandments: bring them back to the laws.
“Abide still, O my people, and take thy rest”: abide still, be patient. Here’s the patience and faith of the saints.
“As for the servants whom I have given thee, there shall not one of them perish; for I will require them from among thy number”: that’s going to be the select few, required from among that number.
“Be not weary: for when the day of trouble and heaviness cometh, others shall weep and be sorrowful, but thou shalt be merry and have abundance”, because guess what: we win.

“The heathen shall envy thee, but they shall be able to do nothing against thee, saith the Lord”, and there’s nothing you can do about it, buddy. I can imagine the mental stress you are under, the psychosis you’re dealing with. I understand why you hate us: because you hate God. No matter what you do, God said, I made a promise, and he still chose these people.
“My hands shall cover thee, so that thy children shall not see hell”: his hands shall cover us, so we will not be fully destroyed.

“Be joyful, O thou mother, with thy children; for I will deliver thee, saith the Lord. Remember thy children that sleep, for I shall bring them out of the sides of the earth, and shew mercy unto them: for I am merciful, saith the Lord Almighty.” So now you understand why the heathen will envy you: because we still come back up on top. Even the dead are coming back. The righteous are going to come back, the ones you killed off, the ones you thought you were going to stop.

precepts.why:
Jump back one chapter. “They have seen no prophets, yet they shall call their sins to remembrance, and acknowledge them. I take to witness the grace of the people to come, whose little ones rejoice in gladness: and though they have not seen me with bodily eyes, yet in spirit they believe the thing that I say. And now, brother, behold what glory; and see the people that cometh from the east: Unto whom I will give for leaders, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, Oseas, Amos, and Micheas, Joel, Abdias, and Jonas, Nahum, and Abacuc, Sophonias, Aggeus, Zachary, and Malachy, which is called also an angel of the Lord.”

He’s going to send the prophets back. Many times in history we didn’t listen to the prophets, but he said he’s going to send them back again. So the nations now are frustrated, because whatever they do they can never win; they never have a chance.

Now you see why, when we were coming up in our stupidity in the world, they taught us reincarnation: you come back as a damn eagle, a grasshopper, a butterfly floating in Kansas. Anything to throw you off the path, that the prophets will one day come back and set you in order, so you could have no hope in this captivity; they wanted you to stay on the bottom. God said, all right guys, it’s already rigged. He’s going to send them back; it’s going to be over; they’re going to set them in order once again. That’s why they pitched that stuff on us so hard.

sense.text:
“For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult”: God, your enemies are making a tumult, an uprising, confusion or disorder. They’re angry: ‘Damn it, I got all the earth, I’m living the best, the best of the earth is mine, Monte Carlo, whatever, and I’m about to lose this.’ Your enemies. But why would they be enemies to God?

“And they that hate thee have lifted up the head.”

“They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.” They did that back in the Maccabees; they did it in the book of Daniel, changing their names, trying to get them to bow down. In the Maccabees you couldn’t circumcise your children; they fought you to become Hellenized. They did it here in America: God bless America, Fourth of July, turkey, all that stuff. They take crafty counsel against thy people.

“They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.” Thus the last names Jenkins, Thompson, Pierre, Rodriguez. ‘We’ve got to have a plan, we’ve got to cut them off. Let’s break their bands, break their brotherhood: we got that. Now we’ve got to separate them from the laws of God: we got that. Separate their families, take the man out of the house: we got that. Jay-Z, give them an album so they can rap about drugs. Beyonce, twerk and do a video for me. Al Sharpton, teach them that the church can’t judge gay people. Creflo, take their money and tell them they’re going to get a blessing.’ Crafty counsel, that the name of Israel be no more in remembrance.

Christianity puts our people in a deep sleep, so that when we read Psalms 83 we think that crafty counsel was long ago and then it was over. But the crafty counsel has evolved over a long period of time to make sure the name of Israel never comes back into remembrance. Now, with what Kanye said, the word they use is anti-Semitism. This is how you know they’re not the people of the book: they call themselves Israeli, they call themselves Jewish. They don’t want the name Israelite, Judah, Benjamin, Levi to come back into the earth, so nobody will ever connect black folk, Hispanics and Native Indians with the name Israelite. That’s the crafty counsel evolving in today’s time. Very good point.

“For they have consulted together with one consent”: all the nations have conspired together. That’s why it doesn’t matter where we go on the earth; when we go to China, the black people in China are in the hood, in the ghettos. No matter where we go, we’re at the bottom. They’ve all conspired together; they all make a mockery of us. Laugh on, get your laugh. I’m good, I can be patient. But there will be a big black guy that’s going to come out of the sky. You’ll see.

precepts.why:
Why would they be enemies to God? “For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem, I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land. And they have cast lots for my people”. “Yea, and what have ye to do with me, O Tyre, and Zidon”: and who are Tyre and Sidon? We read it earlier, in 2 Esdras 1.

“And all the coasts of Palestine? will ye render me a recompence?” Are you trying to pay me back for what I did to you? Man, the earth is mine and the fulness thereof; you think you’re going to pay me back? That’s like somebody moving into your place, you’re trying to help them out, and when it’s time for them to go they get mad at you: I gave you a place to stay; get your stuff and get up out of here.

“And if ye recompense me, swiftly and speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head”. That’s why they’re angry. Don’t play with me: you pay me back by carrying them into captivity, and I’m going to return it right back on your own head. He that leads into captivity: so Tyre and Sidon, you Hamites, guess what, captivity’s for you.

“All the nations have I destroyed before them, and in the east I have scattered the people of two provinces, even of Tyrus and Sidon”. So guess why they’re angry: because he scattered Tyre and Sidon; he kicked them out of the land, for who? For us. ‘Damn, we was good, we was comfortable in the whole district. All right God, we see what you did. We’re going to get back at you.’

God said, you dummy, you’re not getting back at me. I’m punishing them; I’m allowing you to punish them. But I’m going to make you carry them into captivity, and then I’m going to punish you for carrying them into captivity. You know why? Because I can do it, and who’s got something to say? I can’t hear you. God is a taunter; he mocks.

sense.text: So the question again is why do the heathen rage? Here’s why. “And after these, Adam also, whom thou madest lord of all thy creatures: of him come we all, and the people also whom thou hast chosen.” Out of Adam came all people, but more importantly there’s a people who was chosen. If they’re chosen, they are a special people, above all the people of the earth. That’s us, buddy.

“All this have I spoken before thee, O Lord, because thou madest the world for our sakes.” Not for everybody: for our sake. These special people who are chosen, above all people, he made the world for them. So you can’t give me forty acres and a mule and think I’m good. I want the whole earth back.

“As for the other people, which also come of Adam, thou hast said that they are nothing.” The other people, below these special people, also came out of Adam, and God says they are nothing. Imagine being another nation and hearing that God made people, but the other people are nothing. Would you be happy, or would you be raging? You would be raging. That’s why I understand why the heathen rage: why did you make us to be nothing?

“But be like unto spittle.” He says you’re nothing, and then he compares you to something: spit. God is not to be messed with; his words are sharp. Now you see why they took it out. That’s what you are, spit. That’s harsh. If you ain’t Israel, you’re that drool dried up on the pillow.

“And hast likened the abundance of them unto a drop that falleth from a vessel.” That’s why they don’t want the truth of this Bible to come out. God said you’re insignificant to me, you mean nothing to me, you’re fitted for destruction. We are all tools to God: you’re going to be used or you’re useless, used for what to do or what not to do. But we have a chance; the other nations have no chance. You could cry him a river, cry for the white man all you want, and you’re going to die of dehydration, because it ain’t meant for them or nobody else but you. And we’re the only people always worried about everybody else, don’t got a pot to piss in but worried about everybody else.

Then we’re the bad guy when we say we’re the Israelites. I’m the bad guy: I’m an Israelite, I’m of the tribe of Benjamin, and I could prove it. The rest of you are spit to God, like one little drop in a bucket. And he’s not talking about one person: nations, hundreds of millions, billions of people, just a drop. That’s got to hurt. Rage makes sense. And then I got to look at your black … and say you’re the kings of the earth, you’re the gods of the earth? Not as long as I’m alive, you ain’t.

You can make a song about murdering babies and it’s all right, it’s on YouTube, it’s all right in the world. Say you’re an Israelite and the world is about to fall apart. Yes it is about to fall apart. ‘Ask, and I will give you the heathen’: well I’m asking God, give them to me, all of them.

“And now, O Lord, behold, these heathen, which have ever been reputed as nothing.” They’ve always been nothing. You think because they put on a suit and tie they’re something? God said they’ve always been nothing and they’ll always be nothing. They just sit in a place for a moment so we can see that these people that are nothing are over us. We really messed up, we really sinned against God, to have people that are nothing over us, heathens dragging their knuckles all over us telling us what to do. Our family should be ashamed to have these nations over us; it’s a provoking to repentance.

“Have begun to be lords over us, and to devour us.” They devour us with their sorceries; they kill us in the streets, the people that are nothing. We are the chosen people above all nations, so I understand why you’re angry: you’re over God’s people, and you got a place, but it’s just for a period of time.
“But we thy people (whom thou hast called thy firstborn, thy only begotten, and thy fervent lover) are given into their hands.”

“If the world now be made for our sakes.” That’s the question he had: these people ain’t nobody, God, you know that because you made them and you told us they ain’t nothing, and the world was made for our sakes. “Why do we not possess an inheritance with the world? how long shall this endure?” Come on, Lord: give me the heathen for an inheritance, I want them.

How long is this supposed to last? There’s an urgency of frustration on our end, and a mad dash on the end of the other nations to keep us in the place we’re at.

precepts.why: “Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?” We always knew the kingdom belongs to us. It was never all nations. They asked him right there the same thing Ezra asked: how long shall we endure this? Ezra understood. This is a time now to restore the kingdom to us.

“For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.” Read on: “And as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem, and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear.” They thought the kingdom of God was going to immediately appear. So we always knew the kingdom belonged to us.

It’s just in these last days they don’t know that, but we the Israelites that are capable understand the kingdom is for us. That’s why a scripture like Saint John 3:16, God so loved the world that he gave his only begotten son that whosoever, has been used: the witchcraft of religion has changed the words of God away from what they mean to something else. The whosoever is Israel.

We already knew the earth was made for our sakes, and the nations understood that. Why do you think Herod wanted to kill Christ as a baby? To stop the prophecies: this baby is going to be born, grow up, live and die for the sins of the children of Israel and bring them back to God, so we got to kill them off. These black people are getting together and uniting: no, break the families apart. Bloods, Crips, Norte, the Spanish-speaking gang-banging people, black, blue, whatever you want to call it: keep them in derision. But when you get locked up, you all sit in the same place.

“And in the days of these kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed.” That’s what they’re worried about. They understand that one day there’s going to be a kingdom that will not be destroyed. The white man says I am raging, I will not allow the kingdom to stand, because once it stands it will never be destroyed, and that means I’ll never rise up again. I’m going to fight the spaceships, the UFOs, with all the military power I have, like Will Smith in that movie Independence Day. No you’re not; you’re going to die in one hour. That’s going to be a sight to see. Just be righteous, because if you’re not righteous you’re dying right along with it.

“And the kingdom shall not be left to other people.” It will not be left to nobody else, because it was left before to other people. You had a chance to taste it, to feel it, and you messed it up. You messed up the earth, but God’s going to purge it and we’re going to take it back. You can feel it slipping from your hands: every class we put out, it slips more and more from you. How do you stop us? Turn off the internet? You can’t; you need it for commerce. Lock him up, kill him? There’s thousands and thousands of men that could teach this, and might do it better. Little kids growing up are prophesying it now. It’s too late. It was too late from Genesis.

“But it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms.” Every kingdom is going to be broke in pieces. Every man that rises up his head is going to fall, because Christ’s kingdom must be established, and when it’s established we are joint heirs with him.

sense.text:
“And he shall speak great words against the most High.” He is the other nation, the white man, speaking great words against the Most High. Here’s one: ‘I’m God.’ “And shall wear out the saints of the most High.” They’re going to kill us in these streets, slaughter us, wear us out. You think we’re going to talk like this and get away with it? That’s not how this thing goes.

“And think to change times and laws”: to throw off the prophecies. They frame law by mischief. Today a man can cut off his private, tuck it in, get some estrogen, grow breasts, and it’s hate speech to call him a him. If you cut your stuff off, you’re committed to your act, but you’re still a him; the Bible calls that a eunuch. But I’m the bad guy.

“And they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time.” They’re given into his hand for a period of time. That’s the whole point: you’re just for a period of time.

“But the judgment shall sit.” God’s judgment is going to sit, and his judgment ain’t going to change. He just got it for a time, times and a period of time. And what is God’s judgment that’s going to sit? We will win. “And they shall take away his dominion, to consume and to destroy it.” It ain’t going nowhere, buddy. You lose, we win.

“And the kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High.” That’s a fire scripture. The kingdom, the dominion, the greatness of the kingdom, everything under the whole heaven, given to the people of the saints of the Most High. Who’s that? That’s us. It’s given to us and nobody else. He said ask of me and I will give you the heathen: I’m asking, give me the heathen. That’s in the Bible, buddy. Where do you get everybody from? Witchcraft. The kingdom is for Israel.

“Whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him.” Right now they’re standing in their rulership, and it’s the last kingdom, and they’re going to fight. We’re stripping it piece by piece out of their hand, raising up the people, and they’re losing it, and they’re stressed out. That’s why they’re raging: Lord, I’m losing it, what do I do, I got to stop this. And you can’t stop it.

So from a conscious mind, I understand why they’re angry. I understand why they hate us. I’m not confused. You Christian church folk are confused, and that’s why you keep getting beat over your head and you still want to love them. Not me. I’m clear: we’re taking back our place, and they don’t want to give it up.

precepts.why:
Hold this; we’re going to come back to Daniel. What is God’s judgment that is going to sit? “Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure.” He declared the end, how this all plays out, from the beginning. We read the script; we know how it ends, buddy. You can fool some of the people some of the time, but you can never fool the Israelites none of the time.

Read on: “Calling a ravenous bird from the east, the man that executeth my counsel from a far country: yea, I have spoken it, I will also bring it to pass; I have purposed it, I will also do it.” “Hearken unto me, ye stouthearted, that are far from righteousness: I bring near my righteousness”, “and my salvation shall not tarry: and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel my glory.”

At the end of this he’s going to place salvation in Zion, and Israel is his glory, and that will stand. That’s the judgment that sits in Daniel 7: it ain’t going nowhere.

sense.text:
Here is another reason why, if we were them, we would be angry. The law says “Ye shall not eat of any thing that dieth of itself: thou shalt give it unto the stranger that is in thy gates”. Picture it: we are in our land, ruling, the cattle and the people blessed, and a good animal gets sick and dies of itself. One of us goes to make a piece of it, and no, no, no, that is not for you, that is for Esau. Imagine him hearing that: you don’t eat that, you are holy, that is for him. That would make anybody mad. It is roadkill.

It is like today turned around. Right now they eat the good and we are told to go to Walmart; we get the two and a half pound chicken with the bruised wings while they have the big one. Time out: this is your kingdom right now. But the scripture is about that day, and it would make them mad to be handed the animal that died of itself.

Read the rest of it: “that he may eat it; or thou mayest sell it unto an alien: for thou art an holy people unto the Lord thy God.” Now he has to buy it. Sell him the carcass that died of itself, still warm, by the pound: that is adding insult to injury. ‘That’s for you, eat up, enjoy’; he would be pissed.

That is why, when they finally got the chance to get us, they said to destroy it even to the foundation, and they destroyed his people. And the Lord says don’t worry, we are going to return that: I was punishing you all, but that one opened his mouth and said destroy it, so my children are going to dash your children against the stones. He should have shut up.
“Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.” Esau is set out as the profane person: he sold his birthright for one morsel of meat.

“For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected”. The one word that strikes you in it is rejected. That is why it hurts him so much: he sought it “carefully with tears”, he cried, and after all that crying and emotion his father still says no. No cry me a river.

And then the blessing turns to Jacob, the supplanter: that is what the prophecy was, that the elder would serve. We have the greatest comeback story ever; there is no greater comeback than what we just read.

The story is about two brothers, Jacob and Esau. Esau is the elder, and the prophecy was that the elder shall serve the younger. When they came out Jacob was named the supplanter, and he supplanted his brother by taking the birthright from him, but it was supposed to be like that, because that is what God wanted to do.

Now the father is about to die and the sons are coming for the blessings, and Jacob took the blessing that was supposed to go to Esau as the firstborn. When Esau comes in, there is no blessing left for him. “He cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry”: he busted down crying, that ugly face, red, looking maroon like a caveman. “Bless me, even me also, O my father.”

“Thy brother came with subtilty, and hath taken away thy blessing.” And Esau says, “Is not he rightly named Jacob? for he hath supplanted me these two times”.

The first time, Esau was hungry and Jacob said, give me your birthright and you can eat; Esau didn’t care and gave it up. That is how “he took away my birthright”, and the prophecy that the elder would serve the younger was told to their mother before they were even born. “And, behold, now he hath taken away my blessing.” “Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me?”: you don’t have nothing for me, you can’t throw me nothing?

Isaac answers, “Behold, I have made him thy lord”. The him is us. That is why we should be so irate: we are supposed to be lord over these …, and they are lording over us, they love every bit of it, and they don’t want to lose it.

“And all his brethren have I given to him for servants; and with corn and wine have I sustained him: and what shall I do now unto thee, my son?”
“Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.” He wept.

“Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above”. This is the blessing he gets: good land, living good, and he lives in the good now. But you have your period of time where you are going to have it. So you understand why he would have that hatred, and why he rages.

precepts.why:
“For three transgressions of Edom, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he did pursue his brother with the sword, and did cast off all pity, and his anger did tear perpetually, and he kept his wrath for ever”.

His anger was from back then, from the lost blessing, and it tears perpetually: it is still in him today. He is angry, and most of them don’t even understand why they are so angry. It is because we are chosen and they are not. It just is what it is, and that is why they can’t stand your guts.

sense.text: This is prophetic about today, in these last days. “Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon”: he is going to bring them down. “Sit on the ground: there is no throne”: no more rulership, no longer sitting and judging this earth. The earth is no longer going to be given to them.
“I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.” When he comes back he will not meet them as a man this time. So how is he going to meet them? Second Esdras shows it.

precepts.why:
“That man waxed strong with the thousands of heaven”, and “whensoever the voice went out of his mouth, all they burned that heard his voice, like as the earth faileth when it feeleth the fire.” That is how he will not meet them as a man: when he comes back, he is burning.

“There was gathered together a multitude of men, out of number, from the four winds of the heaven, to subdue the man that came out of the sea”. The four winds are the armies that are going to come to try to subdue him, and the man that came out of the sea is Christ. That is how angry they are: we are about to lose everything, we have to fight; if we can destroy him we can hold on to this kingdom. Army, Navy, Air Force, Marines, mount up to die.

“He had graved himself a great mountain, and flew up upon it”: that is his chariot. Then “all they which were gathered together to subdue him were sore afraid, and yet durst fight.” They were afraid but they still fought, because they knew they were about to lose everything. You are going to see a big black man with angels come out of the sky in chariots with fire breathing out of his mouth. He told them, I am coming back like no man next time; he is not going to be fighting in the middle of the street. But everything is on the line for them: mayday, mayday.

“He neither lifted up his hand, nor held sword, nor any instrument of war”. He sees them coming in their violence, raging, and he does not lift a hand or a sword. You are a joke: I made you for this purpose, so I can destroy you.

“But only I saw that he sent out of his mouth as it had been a blast of fire, and out of his lips a flaming breath, and out of his tongue he cast out sparks and tempests.” That is our King, and nobody else. The armies come at him in rage and he holds his hands down; he has to hold back, because if he put it all on he would destroy everything, so he gives them just enough.

“The blast of fire, the flaming breath, and the great tempest”, “fell with violence upon the multitude which was prepared to fight, and burned them up every one, so that upon a sudden of an innumerable multitude nothing was to be perceived, but only dust and smell of smoke”. There was nothing left: flat, burnt, scorched ash. Look for a leg, there is no leg; look for an ankle, there is no ankle. Something was there, and now nothing is there.

“When I saw this I was afraid.” That is heavy: Ezra was afraid, even though he saw that it was salvation for him.

sense.text: “Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame”. This is that fire out of his mouth. “There shall not be a coal to warm at, nor fire to sit before it”: the fire is so intense it is not a fire to warm by; it annihilates everything in its path. No fighters, no tanks, nothing; whatever he breathes out is so intense that nothing will stand and nothing will last. The best we can understand of it, never having experienced it, is when a body is cremated, and that is play next to this. Zero left of the thing you came to fight.

“For thou shalt no more be called, The lady of kingdoms.” You had your place one time and were called the lady of kingdoms, but now I am going to bring you down to the earth, I am going to burn you up.

“I was wroth with my people, I have polluted mine inheritance”. He did that because he was wroth with his people. That is the reason they are where they are right now: not because he chose them, but because he was angry with his people. He had to use them to pay us back, to let us know: look at these people I did not choose, I put them over you. That is to get us angry.

“And given them into thine hand: thou didst shew them no mercy”: when you had them, you showed my people no type of mercy. “Upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke”: on all the ancients you laid a heavy yoke.

“And thou saidst, I shall be a lady for ever”. In her inward thoughts she thought she was going to stand forever. Esau, red man: I was just using you, and you got beside yourself.

“So that thou didst not lay these things to thy heart”: you did not lay it to heart, I better be careful how I deal with his people, even though God is using me to punish them; I shouldn’t get beside myself. “Neither didst remember the latter end of it”: you forgot that at the end you are not going to be there forever. White man, red man, Chinese man, none of you is going to be there forever; you forgot that we come back into place eventually. You should have done what God said and played nice a little bit, but you didn’t, so it is going to be returned to you tenfold.

“Thou that art given to pleasures, that dwellest carelessly, that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me”: you got to the point where you think you are beyond God. “I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children”.

“But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood”: you are going to learn. “They shall come upon thee in their perfection for the multitude of thy sorceries, and for the great abundance of thine enchantments.”

“For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness: thou hast said, None seeth me.” “Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee”: the wisdom he allowed them to have perverted them. “Thou hast said in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me”: with the witchcraft wisdom he allowed them to have, they thought they were smarter than him.

“Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth”, and “desolation shall come upon thee suddenly, which thou shalt not know.” It is happening right now. You don’t know when it is going to happen: he is giving them Jeremiah and Isaiah, these prophets rising back up on the earth, and they are going to turn this thing upside down right in the midst of them. They thought we couldn’t read, but now we can read and comprehend the word of God, and many of us are coming up right now, right in their face.

That is why they are angry: they know they can’t stop it. It is inevitable; we win. You only lose when you stop keeping these commandments; you are always slated to win. And for the ones of us that don’t make it, there will be gnashing of teeth: I don’t want to go with them, God. Keep these laws and commandments.

“Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth; if so be thou shalt be able to profit, if so be thou mayest prevail.” When America is burning, stand there with all your enchantments and your witchcraft that you thought was going to work, and let’s see how it works out for you.

“Hear ye this, O house of Jacob, which are called by the name of Israel, and are come forth out of the waters of Judah, which swear by the name of the Lord, and make mention of the God of Israel, but not in truth, nor in righteousness.” That is the people in the churches: they are not right. The chapter before says this land is going to fall, while we are in captivity here, but those church people are not calling on him by his right name; they are not calling the Lord correctly. That goes back to Romans 10: they have the zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.

“For my name’s sake will I defer mine anger”: for the sake of the name Israel. “And for my praise will I refrain for thee, that I cut thee not off.” God is never going to fully cut us off; he defers his anger.
“Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.” That is what we are going through right now.
“I will not give my glory unto another.” He is never going to give it to anybody else; it is coming back to us.
“The Lord hath loved him: he will do his pleasure on Babylon, and his arm shall be on the Chaldeans.” What is his pleasure on Babylon? To destroy them.
“And now, saith the Lord that formed me from the womb to be his servant, to bring Jacob again to him”, “and my God shall be my strength.”
“But Zion said, The Lord hath forsaken me, and my Lord hath forgotten me.” Zion, the land, says the Lord has forsaken her.

“Thy children shall make haste”: the children are going to make haste to get back to our land. “Thy destroyers and they that made thee waste shall go forth of thee”: we are going to put them out of that land. Why? Because God has never forsaken us. We are going to make haste to go back.

precepts.why:
What will we do in that land? “For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land: and the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.” That is what is going to happen: the strangers are going to be joined to us in our own land and cleave to us, and they are going to be slaves.

You cannot change prophecy, you cannot change what God said he is going to do. You may not like it, but it is what it is, and there is nothing we can do about it.

sense.text:
“And kings shall be thy nursing fathers, and their queens thy nursing mothers”: in that land, their kings are going to be nursing fathers. “They shall bow down to thee with their face toward the earth, and lick up the dust of thy feet”. “For they shall not be ashamed that wait for me”: we are not going to be ashamed.

He said, ask of me and I will give you the heathen for an inheritance. So we are asking: Lord, give me some nursing fathers and mothers, some people that are going to lick the dust of my feet, back in the land, joined to me. That is where I need them.

precepts.why:
“And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place: and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the Lord for servants and handmaids: and they shall take them captives, whose captives they were”. We read that in Revelation 13: he that leads into captivity shall go into captivity. We are going to take them captive.

Who is this talking about? Every nation that played a part in destroying us, the ones of Psalms 83 and Psalms 2, every nation that had us and took part in spoiling us. “And they shall rule over their oppressors”: we are going to rule over those that oppressed us.

That being said, you would understand why the heathen rage.

sense.text: They have always tried to stop us from coming back into place. “By their secret plots, and popular persuasions and commotions, they hindered the finishing of the building all the time that king Cyrus lived: so they were hindered from building for the space of two years, until the reign of Darius.” Back in the time of the Persians they tried to hinder us from building back up the temple and the city. Why? Because they were afraid we were going to come back into rulership eventually, and what does that mean for them? They fall. So they hindered us and tried to stop us time and time again.

precepts.why: “They which builded on the wall, and they that bare burdens, with those that laded, every one with one of his hands wrought in the work, and with the other hand held a weapon.” When we tried to build back, we had to have one hand on the building and one hand on a sword, because these nations tried to hinder us. It is going to be the same thing in these last days.

“And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus”. This dragon is going to be wroth with us. They are going to rage and be upset because they are going to lose their place, and it doesn’t matter: we win. Heathens, your days are numbered.
